description.en: Turn the article in your browser tab into clean, readable text in a tab of its own: title, byline, headings, lists, quotes and code. Its links and images stay one click away.
description.ja: ブラウザタブの記事を、読みやすいテキストにして専用のタブに表示します。タイトル、著者、見出し、リスト、引用、コードを読みやすく並べ、リンクや画像もクリックひとつで開けます。

tagline.en: Read any article as clean text, without the clutter
tagline.ja: 記事を、余計なもののない読みやすいテキストで

scopes.page:read: Read the article text and links of the browser tab you're looking at, when you ask.
scopes.actions:run: Open the Reader tab, and open a link or image you click in a browser tab.
scopes.storage:local: Keep the last article you read on this Mac, so it's still there after a reload.
